page.notes: The Greek phrase after "transparens à" is not legible enough to copy; the second Greek word is read as ἁπλῶς with doubt. A small reference mark stands before "exprobrantium" at the left edge of the column; no matching note is printed on this page. The signature "P 5" at the foot is uncertain. The running head is set in small capitals in the original and is copied here in mixed case. The page ends mid-word with the catchword "hen-".
